newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian border guards kill two on Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Russian border guards kill two on Afghan border.

text.p: Russian border guards have shot dead two armed people attempting to cross into Tajikistan from neighbouring Afghanistan, a Russian military spokesman said on Thursday.
The incident late on Wednesday was the second of its kind in two days. On Tuesday, Russian troops shot dead another two people trying to slip across the border.
Around 20,000 Russian troops are deployed in the former Soviet republic of Tajikistan, guarding its remote, mountainous border.
Russia and Tajikistan see the troops as a shield against militant Islamist extremism spreading northwards from Afghanistan.

Earlier this week senior Tajik security officials, worried by the advance of the purist Islamist Taleban militia in northern Afghanistan, discussed urgent measures to reinforce the Afghan border and prevent a massive influx of refugees.
Tajikistan's secular government and the united Islamist opposition agreed last year on a ceasefire to end a four-year civil war that left tens of thousands dead and many more displaced.
But the fragile peace is often disturbed by maverick armed bands and drug traders operating out of their bases in Afghanistan.
